notes: Adds a modern WiseGPO installation screen and clearer, reliable IP reporting.
added: wiseTool presents installation with a clear phase, percentage, progress bar, and concise diagnostics.
All user-facing hardware names now use WiseGPO terminology.
Detected fixed and custom IP addresses remain visible while optional assignment completes.
fixed: The Windows online checker uses TLS 1.2 reliably.
Post-installation status no longer replaces a detected IP with a network-assignment error.
